name: Player (all classes)
notes: Starting numbers from mw-e02.2, tuned for tight, weighty third-person movement. Run 5.0 m/s matches a humanoid guard's run, so outpacing a chase takes sprint (7.5); crouch 2.2. Reaches run speed in 0.15 s and stops in 0.10 s so the player never feels on ice. Gravity 25 m/s² (about 2.5 g) gives a 1.2 m jump a quick 0.31 s rise: weight over floatiness. Air control 30% lets the player correct a jump without steering like a bird. Coyote 120 ms and jump buffer 150 ms forgive edge and landing timing; both are the design ceilings. Steps 0.35 m (stairs and kerbs, not waist-high crates) and walks 45° slopes. Capsule 0.35 m radius, 1.8 m tall standing (the humanoid agent size), 1.0 m crouched so the player fits under 1.2 m gaps. Per-class overrides (mw-e02.3) hold only what a class changes: the thief crouches at 2.6 m/s instead of 2.2, so sneaking keeps pace with a walking guard; every other class moves on the base values. Armor weight is not an override: its load class modifies whichever profile applies (ADR-0003, mw-e17.13). Gait (mw-e02.6, starting defaults to tune in play): the published locomotion state is idle below 0.2 m/s, walk from 0.2 and run from 2.5 m/s (half the run speed, so a light stick push reads as a walk); a landing of 6 m/s or more (a drop of about 0.7 m, so every full jump) shows 150 ms of landing; footsteps fall every 0.75 / 1.6 / 2.05 / 1.0 m walking / running / sprinting / crouching, spaced as the shipped clips step (a walk of 2 steps a second at 1.5 m/s, a run of about 3.1 at 5 m/s, a sprint of 3.6 at 7.5, a crouch of 2.2 at 2.2) so a footstep sounds when a foot lands (it was 1.0 m for the run, 5 sounds a second against 3 steps drawn). Launch (mw-e02.15, placeholder until the combat sandbox tunes it): a self-cast push keeps 10% air control so the caster can nudge the landing; a staggering launch has none, and its landing locks movement for 250 ms so being blasted reads as a consequence. Mass 90 kg (an armoured humanoid, mw-e04.34) is the player's weight for force stimuli: a 720 N·s blast changes its velocity by 8 m/s. Ledges (mw-e02.12, placeholder values to tune in play, mw-e02.19): walking into a ledge up to 1.0 m mantles on its own in 0.4 s; jump mantles up to 1.6 m in 0.6 s for every class; a grab reaches 2.2 m (ledge-hang capability) and hangs with the feet 2.0 m below the edge, catching it in 0.25 s, pulling up in 0.7 s or lowering over an edge in 0.5 s. Jump presses find ledges up to 1.0 m ahead; hands catch within 0.3 m. Tops steeper than 20° are no place to stand. Shimmy 1.0 m/s across gaps up to 0.3 m; a ledge that freezes or catches fire is held 1.0 s before the hands let go; a jump off a hang pushes 4 m/s away and 6 m/s up. Climbing (mw-e02.13, placeholder values to tune in play, mw-e02.19): ladders 1.2 m/s, ropes 1.0, ivy and rough stone 0.8 (the default surface speed), sheer faces 0.6; walking into a ladder, rope or ivy attaches (every class), while rough and sheer faces need a jump at them so bumping a stone wall never starts a climb; surfaces are caught within 0.3 m; hands reach 2.0 m above the feet (the same as a ledge hang), so a climber pulls up onto a ledge that high; corners up to 45° are followed; a surface that freezes or catches fire is held 1.0 s; climbing drains 5 stamina/s (20 s on a full knight bar; progression takes over in mw-e10.9); a jump off pushes 4 m/s away and 5 m/s up. Stealth (mw-e02.10, starting defaults to tune in play): holding slow walk caps the speed at 1.2 m/s, and a light stick (30% deflection or less, 1.5 m/s) also counts as a slow walk. Noise multipliers standing: still 0, slow walk 0.08, walk 0.3, run 0.6, sprint 1.0; crouched: still 0, slow walk 0.05, walk 0.15 (moving crouched is a walk at any crouch speed, so the thief's faster crouch is not punished), with run 0.3 and sprint 0.6 defined for completeness (the controller never crouch-runs or crouch-sprints: sprint stands the character up). Visibility multipliers: standing 0.8 still, 0.85 slow walk, 0.9 walk, 1.0 run and sprint; crouched about half (0.4 still and slow walk, 0.45 walk, 0.5 run and sprint), matching the AI harness's halving for a crouch. Armor does not change visibility (ADR-0003); its load-class noise multiplier is applied on top, clamped to 1.0. Water (mw-e02.14, placeholders to tune in play): feet in 0.5-1.2 m of water wade at 60% of run speed with no sprint; deeper than 1.2 m, light and medium armor load swim (3.0 and 2.0 m/s, 1 and 4 stamina/s, feet hanging 1.3 m below the surface so the head stays dry, crouch dives at 1.5 m/s) while heavy and overloaded load sink at 2.0 m/s to the bottom and walk it at 40% of run speed (the owner's 'the armor drags you under'). The mouth is 1.6 m above the feet; breath lasts 20 s underwater and refills in 2 s; once empty a drowning event of 10 points (placeholder until e04 prices it) fires every 1000 ms.
